_comment: Template for the OpenZeppelin Relayer v1.5.x configuration.
This file is COMMITTED and contains placeholders only. tools/gen-relayer-config.mjs
substitutes the real values and writes config/config.json, which is gitignored.
The indirection exists because the relayer's config.json has no environment-variable
substitution for RPC URLs, and a Polygon Amoy endpoint from most providers carries an
API key. Committing this file with the key inlined would put a live credential in git
history, so the generated file is the one the service reads and the one git ignores.
The signer below is the ONLY thing that changes when moving to AWS KMS: replace the
`local` signer with an `aws_kms` one and restart the container. No application code,
no interface, and no test is aware of which signer is in use.
